faqs.q: Are there any special discounts on AU Fi MagniFi Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, AU Fi MagniFi Credit Card offers 20% off (up to Rs. 100 per month) on BookMyShow, Amazon, Zepto, and Zomato food orders, with a minimum spend of Rs. 500, applicable only on weekends, making it ideal for weekend entertainment, dining, and online shopping.

faqs.q: How can I redeem my Fi-Points?
faqs.a: With the AU Fi MagniFi Credit Card, 1 Fi-Point equals Rs. 0.25. Fi-Points can be redeemed to pay your card bill, convert into air miles, or get up to 50% off on gift vouchers via the Fi Money app, giving you flexible ways to use your rewards for shopping, travel, or everyday expenses.

faqs.q: Can I convert purchases into EMI?
faqs.a: Yes, transactions of Rs. 500 or more can be converted into EMI by clubbing up to 20 billed or unbilled transactions, with a total EMI value up to Rs. 2,000, making it easier to manage larger or multiple purchases.

faqs.q: Does AU Fi MagniFi Credit Card offer lounge access or premium travel benefits?
faqs.a: No, this card does not provide airport lounge access or premium travel perks. It is primarily designed for everyday spends.

faqs.q: Are there any exclusions on rewards?
faqs.a: Yes, you cannot earn rewards on EMI, fuel, rent, insurance, government, and educational spends.

faqs.q: Who should get the AU Fi MagniFi Credit Card?
faqs.a: AU Fi MagniFi Credit Card is a lifetime-free card ideal for weekend spenders and frequent Zepto or Amazon shoppers, offering high weekend rewards and flexible Fi-Point redemptions, making it a practical choice for everyday spending, dining, entertainment, and online shopping.
